description: This file manages Google Chat account configurations, including resolving credentials, merging account settings, and listing enabled accounts within a larger application.

methods.name: mergeGoogleChatAccountConfig
methods.description: Merges default and specific account configurations for Google Chat, considering account overrides and defaults.

methods.name: parseServiceAccount
methods.description: Parses the service account information, handling secret references and JSON strings.

methods.name: resolveCredentialsFromConfig
methods.description: Resolves credentials and credential source for a given Google Chat account configuration.

methods.name: resolveGoogleChatAccount
methods.description: Resolves a Google Chat account configuration, including credentials and enabled status.

methods.name: listEnabledGoogleChatAccounts
methods.description: Lists all enabled Google Chat accounts based on the current configuration.
